ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What process does this diagram portray on the right?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the right side of the diagram, there is a circular sequence with arrows. It shows adult butterflies at the top, small round egg-like forms on the right, a caterpillar/larva at the bottom, and a chrysalis/pupa near the center-left, with arrows connecting the stages back toward the adult butterfly. Reasoning: These stages match butterfly development: egg → caterpillar/larva → pupa/chrysalis → adult butterfly. Therefore, the process portrayed on the right is the life cycle of a butterfly.
